title: Craft Blend 3-Mix Trio #11 (YorubaAdireEleko+SpanishAndalusian+AmericanArtDeco / VasarelyOpArt+ChineseCizhou+RomanianHorezu / UkrainianPysanka+IslamicGeometric+CroatianHvar)
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio.

A photograph of THREE women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her early 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair porcelain skin, soft pink blush across the cheeks, sparkling pink eyeshadow, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy candy-pink lips, a sweet princess-like smile, demure and soft, vivid copper-orange hair styled in countless fine micro braids, real living eyes. Long square nails, glittery finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. An immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. A gigantic bust resting on the top fold, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 3 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Yoruba adire eleko pattern (a deep indigo ground with bold cream resist-painted geometric motifs, wide cream bands, dense geometric bird motifs) dominates one zone. Spanish Andalusian filigree (a deep black ground with fine silver filigree in geometric star patterns, wide silver bands, dense geometric star filigree) dominates the second zone. American Art Deco chrome-and-lacquer (a deep black lacquer ground with bold silver chrome sunburst, wide silver chrome bands, dense zigzag linework) dominates the third zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Left woman's pose: wide lunging stance, one leg forward.

Left woman's footwear: extreme platform stiletto Mary Janes, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Center woman: a real adult Emirati woman in her early 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, smoky bronze eyes, a soft nude lip, warm golden-tan skin, an elegant composed expression, cool and composed, deep jet-black with a glossy sheen hair styled in curly, real living eyes. Long square nails, holographic finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 3 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Vasarely-inspired optical-illusion pattern (a repeating grid of squares bulging in a 3D illusion, wide silver bands, dense optical illusion grid) dominates one zone. Chinese Cizhou sgraffito ceramic (a glossy jet-black glaze carved to cream-white peony scrolls, wide carved cream bands, dense leaf scrolls) dominates the second zone. Romanian Horezu ceramic (a cream ground with green, brown and ochre spiral floral motifs, wide ochre bands, dense spiral floral bands) dominates the third zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Center woman's pose: caught mid-jump, feet off the ground.

Center woman's footwear: extreme platform stiletto slingbacks, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Right woman: a real adult French woman in her mid 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair natural skin with a light dewy finish, softly brushed natural brows, a barely-there brown liner and fluttering lashes, no eyeshadow, soft natural colour on the cheeks, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a single bold classic red lip with a soft matte finish, an unbothered, effortless expression, cheerful, dark roots fading smoothly into sun-kissed lighter ends (balayage) hair styled in a natural afro in a full rounded silhouette, real living eyes. Long oval nails, chrome finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 3 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Ukrainian pysanka egg-art linework (a deep black ground with fine red, gold and white geometric linework, wide gold-and-red bands, dense geometric wax-resist linework) dominates one zone. Islamic geometric star-tile pattern (a dense precise pattern of interlocking eight-pointed stars, wide gold bands, dense geometric star-and-polygon tile) dominates the second zone. Croatian Hvar filigree-inspired linework (an ivory ground with fine cream and gold painted filigree linework, wide gold bands, dense fine filigree linework) dominates the third zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Right woman's pose: both hands framing her own face.

Right woman's footwear: extreme platform stiletto slingbacks, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera.

Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against each woman's skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 8K.
